summary: John's 2nd-great-grand-aunt; Sister Mary Antonia, IHM, a Catholic school teacher.
bio: Mary Heffernan (7 Jan 1879 - 4 Feb 1955) became Sister Mary Antonia of the Sisters of the Immaculate Heart of Mary (IHM) and taught in Catholic schools in New York and Pennsylvania.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
